description:
Rank AI build tools and coding-agent harnesses for an app idea using deterministic, documented scoring (no LLM).

Use when: the user describes something they want to build and asks which AI tool to use. If they already named the tools to choose between, use compare_tools instead.

Behavior: Read-only. Scores use: number of shipped apps per tool on Vibe Shipped, apps matching the idea, platform (web/mobile), coding experience, budget vs stated official pricing, and a preferred harness. Each result has a score breakdown, pricing with checked date and source, and example apps with links.

Example: {"idea":"habit tracker mobile app","platform":"mobile","experience":"beginner","budget_usd_month":25}

budget_usd_month.description: Monthly tool budget in USD; 0 = free tiers only.

idea.description: The app idea in plain text.

preferred_harness.description: Slug or name the user prefers, e.g. claude-code.

name: recommend_stack
title: Recommend an AI build stack
